(Pasaana) |designation=[[Sentience|Sentient]]{{Film|IX}} |class= |subspecies= |races= |height= |length= |wingspan= |mass= |skincolor=[[Color|White]]{{InsiderCite|203|Neal Scanlan: A Force Reawakended}} |haircolor= |feathers= |eyecolor=Black |distinctions=Three [[eye]]s |lifespan= |origin= |habitat= |diet= |language= }} A [[Sentience|sentient]] '''species''' had three [[eye]]s and an upright body build with two [[Limb|arms]]. The [[alien]]s had [[Color|white]] skin, pink [[Mouth|lips]], no visible [[nose]], and prominent eyelids surrounding their black eyes that had no visible sclerae. In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]]. three members of the [[species]] were present on the [[Expansion Region]] [[planet]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' [[Pasaana]]. They were shorter than adult [[Aki-Aki]] and had black, vertical markings over each of their eyes. The three aliens wore matching tan-and-dark-gray–patterned [[robe]]s as well as tan-and-black [[Clothing|headdresses]] that also covered their upper torso. The trio attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the planet's [[Forbidden Valley]], observing the dancing Aki-Aki locals and walking through the crowds of Aki-Aki and other beings. ==Behind the scenes== The species first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]'' [[:File:PasaanaSpeciesConcept-TheArtOfSWTROS.jpg|Concept art]] of the species was done by [[Jake Lunt Davies]], and it featured additional and alternate features not seen in the film, such as a four-fingered hand; [[hair]]; large, pointed [[ear]]s; eyes with visible white sclerae; alternate light bluish or dark tan skin tones; red or bluish regions on the cheeks; and black-colored head wrappings.''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]'' ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the unidentified species (Pasaana)}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]'' *{{InsiderCite|203|Neal Scanlan: A Force Reawakended}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Sentient species]]
